steps.name: text-fallback
steps.summary: GEMINI_TEXT_BACKEND=auto (new default, deploy.sh): src/lib/agent/model.ts tries the Gemini API key, retries the same generateContent once on Vertex only on 402/429/5xx/network (never 400), pins each per-request geminiClient to the backend of its first call (no switch or retry after a tool ran), and an in-memory circuit sends auto straight to Vertex for 10 min after 3x402 in 5 min; health textGenerate uses textModels() (same path); eval makes a client per request and records modelCallsByBackend. Eval 42/42 on the key, median 5.9 s / p90 10.7 s vs Vertex 05-51 36/42, 8.2 / 23.0 s (local .env pins api, so auto itself is unit-tested only, I-125). Live token pins inputAudioTranscription.languageCodes (ko-KR/en-US from locale) and automaticActivityDetection END_SENSITIVITY_HIGH + silenceDurationMs 700; both voice hero runs pass. scripts/wav.ts ttsPcm strips the TTS WAV header (I-124). Docs: ARCHITECTURE, ADR-011, OPERATIONS, README, TESTING (voice-compare row); I-104 fixed, I-105 updated.

steps.name: scenario-data
steps.summary: src/lib/demo/scenarios.ts: 9 scenarios as data (malo: sunja-lunch, not-sure, sold-out, halal, ai-cannot-pay, undo; airport_rail: mei-tickets, which-platform; doughhouse: learned-pizza), ko/en text, sentences reused from evals/examples, every one ends at confirming (stopBeforePay, no paying/paid check). stepDone: cartHas matches item, optional variant, listed groups as option sets, qty = total over matching lines. scenarioProgress(session, scenario, from = 0) checks steps in order from `from`, so the panel must keep doneSteps and pass it back (undo ends on an empty cart, choice taps clear pendingChoice; I-126). Scenarios assume the dine option is set on P2 before talking (MALO, Doughhouse). scenarios.test.ts checks every id against the kiosk data.

steps.name: scenario-panel
steps.summary: D2 scenario guide: src/components/demo/ScenarioGuide.tsx, a third /demo column (w-80, closed by default, [Scenarios] toggle with aria-expanded) listing scenariosFor(kioskId) as cards (title, persona, goal, tags as text pills). Choosing one calls [Try again] (fresh session) and shows a checklist keyed by session id: sentence chips send through AssistantPanel's own path (new onSay prop registers `speak`, which returns ok/error/limit; useChat.send now returns boolean), ticks come from scenarioProgress with a kept doneSteps, and the end says 'Your turn: tap Yes, pay now…' (learned: pay on the kiosk). src/lib/demo/player.ts playScenario: sending → waiting (20 s counted from the agent's answer, 250 ms polling) → paused 1.5 s → done/stopped/failed; one message per step, no retry, never sends unless status is idle/connected/ordering (canSend); Play needs the dine option first on dine kiosks. Tests: player.test.ts (10), e2e/demo-scenarios.spec.ts (halal ticks from an API callStaff; @live Sunja's lunch reaches confirm with 2 lines Fries (L), passed 21 s), demo.qa.spec.ts D2-scenarios-list and D2-scenario-half at 3 sizes plus DEMO_GUIDE profile ([data-scenario-guide]): 0 H, 0 T. AC: lint, build, test 687, test:e2e 11 passed, qa:ui 20 passed, test:e2e:live 6/6. Evidence JSONs rewritten by the runs were not committed (I-099). New issues I-127 (flaky first dev load, font), I-128 (live.test.ts reaches network). Docs: UX C2a and D2, UI_QA demo coverage.

steps.name: ai-actions
steps.summary: D2 'What the AI did' strip. src/lib/agent/actions.ts agentAction(name, args, outcome, ms, cartBefore) → { tool (declared name or 'unknown'), args (mapped command args filtered to id-pattern strings and numbers, plus the line's itemId for line tools), code ('ok' | ErrorCode | NETWORK), pending?, ms }; never message, model text, session id or token. /api/chat returns actions (runChat times each runCommand, tracks the cart between calls); runToolCalls takes optional cart() and onAction() (useLiveVoice getCart/onAction). AssistantPanel onActions prop (/demo only; /assistant never renders it). src/lib/demo/actions.ts actionRow(kiosk, action, locale) → { text from menu data via lineLabel/choiceLabel, tech 'addToCart ✓ 180 ms' | 'confirmCheckout refused (CONFLICT)' }. src/components/demo/ActionStrip.tsx under the phone in DemoApp (rows per session, last 50, newest first, legend, not aria-live; open by default from 1440px via matchMedia at mount, collapsed with a count badge below; legend+rows scroll together, focusable). Layout: phone frame min-h-[480px], strip shrinks; the strip is hidden while status is confirming so [Yes, pay now] stays in view (I-129 fixed, new rule R-009 proposed for class below-fold-action with I-073). Tests: actions.test (6), demo/actions.test (5), chat.test +2, toolRunner.test +1, route.test updated; e2e/demo-actions.spec.ts (answers /api/chat with recorded actions from e2e/recordedActions.ts, no model; checks rows, codes, no ids, hidden at confirm, collapsed at 1280); qa D2-actions-open 1440x900 and D2-actions-collapsed 1280x720, 0 H. AC: lint, build, test 701, test:e2e 13 passed (7 @live skipped), qa:ui 21 passed. Docs: ARCHITECTURE /api/chat response, UX C2b and D2, UI_QA demo coverage. Evidence JSONs rewritten by e2e not committed (I-099).
